The retrieved IUPAC name is 2,16-dimethyl-9-methylidene-7-oxapentacyclo[9.7.0.02,8.06,8.012,16]octadecane-5,15-dione (PubChem CID 19379648).

key_findings.finding: An ORD forward-match record with the specified substrate plus acetic acid, water, and sulfuric acid gives product SMILES `C=C1CC2C3CCC(=O)C3(C)CCC2C2(C)CCC(=O)C(O)=C12`. In mapped form, the substrate's cyclic ether/epoxide oxygen is retained as the product OH, and a double bond is formed at that ring carbon-to-ring-junction bond; the exocyclic methylidene remains unchanged. Thus this record supports acid-induced rearrangement/ring opening with enol formation, rather than hydration of the terminal alkene to a new methyl-bearing alcohol. The retrieved record does not report an experimental yield or time/temperature in the shown output.
